_source: The Western Front Companion, pp. 202-221 and Maps 40-45 (figures as printed; yards). Sectors run north to south.

sectors.attack: diversion either side of the Gommecourt salient, to link up behind it
sectors.nml: 400-500 (56th, after digging a new front line forward)
special: Smoke screen from 07:20; 56th Division leading companies moved out 5 min before the lift and formed up on white tape in no man's land
46th Division lost direction in dense smoke; enfilade fire from the Z

sectors.nml: 350 in the south to 100 in the north
sectors.objective: Puisieux Trench (third line), about 2,000 yards; 31st to swing left to Flank Trench
sectors.artillery: one heavy gun per 44 yards, one field gun per 20 yards; five lifts, the last 3.5 hours after zero
special: Hawthorn Redoubt mine at 07:20; heavy artillery lifted off the German front line at 07:20; 18-pounders lifted at zero
Strongpoints: Serre, Quadrilateral (Heidenkopf), Ridge Redoubt, Hawthorn Redoubt, Y Ravine, Beaumont-Hamel

sectors.nml: about 500 (36th); Leipzig Salient forward trenches about 200 from the British line
sectors.objective: German second position, Mouquet Farm-Grandcourt line (2,500 yards, four defence lines, six redoubts and Thiepval) by 10:10
sectors.artillery: one heavy gun per 57 yards, one field gun per 28 yards; six timed lifts for the heavies, ten for the 18-pounders
special: Divided by the River Ancre and marshy ground
Strongpoints: St Pierre-Divion, Schwaben Redoubt, Thiepval (cellars), Wundtwerk, Leipzig Salient, Nordwerk, Mouquet Farm, Goat and Stuff Redoubts
109th Brigade left its trenches 15 min before the lift and crept to within 100 yards of the German front trench
17th HLI crept to within about 30-40 yards of the Leipzig Salient from 07:23

sectors.nml: 50 to 800; 2nd Middlesex had about 750 up Mash Valley
sectors.objective: Pozières Ridge, about 4,000 yards in three phases; 103rd Brigade had about 6,000 yards to go, all in view
special: Lochnagar (60,000 lb) and Y Sap (40,000 lb) mines two minutes before zero
Attack on either side of La Boisselle except at the Glory Hole
Strongpoints: Ovillers, La Boisselle, Schwaben Höhe, Sausage (Heligoland) Redoubt, Scots Redoubt
103rd (Tyneside Irish) Brigade advanced from Tara and Usna Hills down an open forward slope

sectors.objective: Quadrangle Trench-Bottom Wood-White Trench, 2,000-3,000 yards; Fricourt to be pinched out, then taken by 50th Brigade
sectors.artillery: intense bombardment from 06:25 by about 200 field guns and howitzers and 86 heavy pieces, some French
special: Stokes mortars joined at 07:22; smoke at 07:27 on the inner flanks
Three Tambour mines (49,000 lb) at 07:28
Gas to be released in the centre, where there was no initial assault
Fricourt and Mametz strongly fortified; some bunkers two storeys deep with electric light

sectors.objective: German first line including Montauban; 18th Division about 2,000 yards to Montauban Alley on a 2,000-yard front with all three brigades in line
special: Hurricane bombardment by six Stokes batteries at 07:22 from Russian saps
Kasino Point mine fired late, as the infantry were already advancing
Strong French heavy artillery support; German second line about 2,000 yards behind the first
Strongpoints: Pommiers Redoubt, The Castle, Glatz Redoubt, The Loop, The Warren

frenchOnRight: French Sixth Army took all its objectives; the 39th Division attacked next to the 30th Division (Commandant Le Petit, 3/153rd, with Lt-Col Fairfax, 17th King's). South of the Somme the French attacked at 09:30.
